title: Chad Dais Nabi Da Syedan Nay
body:
Mehman Nawazi Khoob Howi (x2) Ghut Paani Toh Tarsaye Nay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Meray Piyo Day Maran Diyan Khabran (x2)
Kujh Rahi Lay Kay Aaye Nay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ditay Laag Syedaniyan Wadh Wadh Kay (x2)
Kaye Sir Ran Diyan Chadaran Day Chadiyan (x2)
Kay Bachray Vail Karaye Nay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Meray Na Sohray Na Paykay Rahay (x2)
Kai Din Shagna Day Aaye Nay.
